intro:
Pandjong is a captivating puzzle browser game developed by GamePix that will keep you on the edge of your seat. This delightful game combines elements of solitaire and card games, with a unique twist that is sure to hook you from the very start. Your goal is to free all 80 adorable pandas by clearing the playing field of cards, using a combination of strategy and a bit of luck. What sets Pandjong apart from other puzzle games is its charming visual style, engaging gameplay, and rewarding progression system. With 80 levels to complete, each with its own set of challenges, Pandjong is a game that will keep you entertained for hours on end.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter a variety of jokers and bonuses that will aid you in your quest to free the pandas. From the standard jokers to suit-specific jokers, each one offers a unique opportunity to simplify the process and make the game more manageable. With the ability to draw cards from your stockpile one at a time, select cards that are one higher or one lower in value to remove them from the playing field, and earn points and strike bonuses by clicking on the pandas, Pandjong is a game that requires a delicate balance of strategy and luck.

Whether you're a seasoned puzzle game veteran or a newcomer to the genre, Pandjong is a game that is sure to provide hours of entertainment. So, grab a cup of your favorite beverage, get comfortable, and get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure to free all 80 pandas!
